Masala Omlette
By: Arunkumar
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:17pm

Ingredients




2 eggs
2 green chillies
1 medium sized onion
1 teaspoon Ginger-garlic paste
Salt to taste
Oil to fry

Preparation

1 Beat the eggs with salt. Saute the finely chopped onion and chillies in a teaspoonful of oil. Add ginger-garlic paste.  Once it cooked, pour the beaten egg and spread it evenly. Cook in simmer for about a minute.

About


Serve hot with Salt bread or with soup. I am using this in breakfast and it is fit for the people those who are diet conscious.
